description: This file contains unit tests for the ExponentialBiased class, specifically testing its randomness properties and methods related to uniformity testing using the Anderson-Darling test.

methods.name: AndersonDarlingInf
methods.description: Calculates the p-value approximation for the Anderson-Darling statistic for z > 0.

methods.name: AndersonDarlingErrFix
methods.description: Provides error correction for the Anderson-Darling approximation for small n.

methods.name: AndersonDarlingPValue
methods.description: Computes the p-value for the Anderson-Darling test given n and the test statistic.

methods.name: AndersonDarlingStatistic
methods.description: Calculates the Anderson-Darling test statistic for a sample.

methods.name: AndersonDarlingTest
methods.description: Performs the Anderson-Darling test for uniformity on a sample and returns the p-value.
